subject: AWS private offer / marketplace listing — reseller commit & billing coordination
messages:
From: Sara Li <sara@cloudresellco.com>
To: tessa.morgan@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-05-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: AWS private offer — reseller enablement and commit

Hi Tessa,

Thanks again for the conversation yesterday — CloudResellCo is ready to move forward with a private offer for our joint customers, we just need to lock down net pricing, SKU mapping, and invoice routing for the CPPO.

Questions:
- Can Redwood confirm the minimum net price (per vCPU-month and token blocks) for the private offer?
- Do you have a preferred SKU mapping template we should use for the AWS CPPO submission?
- What’s the expected lead time from submission to acceptance (we have a customer that wants a 6/1 start date)

We’ll also need a PO template and tax cert on file — attaching our internal PO template in a follow-up.

Can you loop in finance and channel on your side?

Appreciate it,
Sara Li
Partnerships Manager | CloudResellCo
phone: +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Li <sara@cloudresellco.com>
Cc: logan.wright@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai, rafael.mendes@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-05-10T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: AWS private offer — reseller enablement and commit

Sara — thanks, looping in channel and finance to get you concrete numbers and the submission checklist. Attached: RDW_CPPO_pricing_v1.xlsx and AWS_CPPO_submission_checklist.pdf.

Quick answers up front:
- Minimum net price: see attached sheet, we provided three bands based on commit (Starter/Scale/Enterprise). The sheet shows net prices (post-reseller margin) we can accept for CPPO configuration.
- SKU mapping: use tab "SKU_map" in the pricing workbook — it follows the AWS product SKU naming we use for CPPO submissions.
- Timeline: typical AWS CPPO acceptance is ~7–12 business days once submitted, faster if the pricing and SKUs match the marketplace catalog. If you need 6/1 start, we should aim to submit by 5/17.

Next steps I propose:
1) Sara to confirm expected monthly commit (USD) and target net price band.
2) Logan to confirm reseller discount level and commit band on Redwood side.
3) Laura to confirm invoicing path (reseller vs end-customer) and PO requirements.

I’ve cc’d Rafael for technical SKU mapping questions and Logan for partner co-sell mechanics. Happy to set a 30-min sync if helpful.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Head of Marketplace Partnerships | Redwood Inference

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Li <sara@cloudresellco.com>
Cc: tessa.morgan@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai, rafael.mendes@redwood.ai, Emmanuel Ortiz <e.ortiz@aws-partner.amazon.com>
Date: 2026-05-11T08:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: AWS private offer — reseller enablement and commit

Sara — great to see momentum. From channel perspective we can support a tiered reseller margin depending on committed ARR:
- Starter: commit <$10k/mo — reseller margin 12% (net price band A in sheet)
- Scale: $10k–$50k/mo — reseller margin 18% (net price band B)
- Enterprise: >$50k/mo — reseller margin 25% (net price band C)

If CloudResellCo can confirm an expected monthly commit (rough estimate is fine), we’ll lock the band and populate the CPPO pricing fields. We’ll submit with the SKUs in the attached workbook; Rafael, can you validate the latency SKU alias mapping before submission?

Also looping Emmanuel from AWS so he’s aware of the timeline — Emmanuel, any tips to accelerate review on the AWS side?

If everyone agrees, I can book a quick call (30m) tomorrow to finalize. Calendly: https://calendly.com/redwood-marketplace/30

— Logan
Director, Channel Sales | Redwood Inference

From: Sara Li <sara@cloudresellco.com>
To: logan.wright@redwood.ai, tessa.morgan@redwood.ai
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-05-12T14:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: AWS private offer — reseller enablement and commit

Thanks Logan — CloudResellCo can commit to $18k/month net (estimated) to start, and anticipate scaling to ~$45k/mo within six months if the initial customers onboard on schedule. That puts us in the Scale band you outlined.

Attached: CloudResellCo_PO_template.pdf and Reseller_tax_cert.pdf. For billing: we need Redwood to issue invoices to CloudResellCo and we will issue consolidated billing to our customers; please confirm Redwood’s preferred remit and whether you require a W-9 (US) or VAT registration (EU).

We’d like to request an expedited DocuSign for the price schedule and a CPPO submission by 5/17 to hit the 6/1 start. Let me know available times for the sync.

— Sara

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Li <sara@cloudresellco.com>
Cc: tessa.morgan@redwood.ai, logan.wright@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-05-13T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: AWS private offer — reseller enablement and commit

Hi Sara — thanks for the PO and tax cert. A few items from accounting before we finalize routing:
- Redwood prefers to invoice the registered reseller entity for CPPO private offers when the reseller is the contracting party in our reseller agreement. Please confirm the legal entity name and remit address to appear on invoices.
- We will need your W-9 (if US) or VAT registration for EU setups — your Reseller_tax_cert.pdf is helpful but please confirm tax ID.
- For PO routing: we can bill to CloudResellCo PO number; include PO number on the DocuSign or in the HubSpot deal.

I’ve uploaded our vendor onboarding checklist to the shared folder: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/shared/Accounting/VendorOnboarding — please add the completed tax forms there. Once I have the legal name, tax ID, and PO number we’ll confirm invoice routing and expected payment terms (Net 30 unless otherwise negotiated).

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Head of Finance | Redwood Inference

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Li <sara@cloudresellco.com>
Cc: logan.wright@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai, rafael.mendes@redwood.ai, Emmanuel Ortiz <e.ortiz@aws-partner.amazon.com>
Date: 2026-05-14T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: AWS private offer — reseller enablement and commit

All — thank you, this is a good path. Quick recap and next steps to keep to the 5/17 submission: 
1) CloudResellCo confirms $18k/mo commit (Scale band) — confirmed in thread.
2) Redwood to finalize CPPO pricing sheet and upload a DocuSign with the price schedule by EOD 5/15 (Logan + Rafael to confirm SKU mapping). DocuSign draft: https://docusign.com/drafts/rdw-cppo-8421
3) Sara to provide legal entity name, PO number, and tax ID in the shared drive (link above) by 5/16 — Laura will finalize invoice routing once received.
4) Redwood to submit CPPO to AWS on 5/17; Emmanuel, please flag any process items we should be aware of for a quicker review.

Fallback: if AWS review runs long, we will enable a short-term co-bill arrangement (Redwood invoices CloudResellCo; reseller issues credits to end-customers) for go-live on 6/1 and then migrate to the CPPO billing path post-acceptance.

I’ll book the 30-min sync for 5/11/15:00 PT to review the final pricing sheet (if that slot conflicts, rebook via the Calendly link).

Thanks everyone — I’ll push the DocuSign and keep the HubSpot deal updated.

— Tessa
Head of Marketplace Partnerships | Redwood Inference
